correlates.name: Posterior Fibular Head Somatic Dysfunction
correlates.presentation: Referenced at the fibular head, but the entire fibula is assessed; after treatment, recheck by shifting the fibula anterior-posterior and superior-inferior, feeling for ease and evenness of motion.
correlates.pathophysiology: Somatic dysfunction of the fibula in which the fibular head rests posteriorly — the more common scenario compared with an anterior fibular head.
correlates.treatment: BLT of the fibula — contacts at the fibular head and lateral malleolus, balance the seesaw motion (anterior pressure at the posterior component moves it anteriorly and slightly superiorly)…
